title: An 80-Ton Whale Punches Through Two Feet of Arctic Ice

scenes.text: This whale punches through two feet of solid Arctic ice.
It is the bowhead whale, and it weighs up to 80 tons.
It needs air, but the ocean above it is frozen over.
So it swims up and rams the ice with its massive skull.
The ice cracks open and the whale breathes through the hole.
Two feet of ice is no match for 80 tons.

description:
A bowhead whale can punch through ice about two feet thick with its head.
It weighs up to 80 tonnes and needs holes in the ice to breathe.
What is the toughest animal you know?
first_comment: Would you rather meet a bowhead whale or a polar bear?
